# About Sri Murugan Traders

Sri Murugan Traders is a hardware wholesaler founded in 2009 in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

## Contact

Our showroom is at 14 Gandhi Road, Coimbatore 641001. Phone: +91 422 555 0142. Email: sales@srimurugan.example.

## Business hours

We are open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Closed on Sundays.

## Warranty

All electrical products carry a 12 month warranty from the date of purchase. Plumbing products carry a 6 month warranty.

## Delivery

Free delivery within Coimbatore for orders above 5000 INR. Other locations are charged at actual transport cost.
